install.title: Two things, and you’re ready
install.ios1: In Safari, tap the Share button at the bottom
install.ios3: Open SHURJ from the Home Screen, not from Safari
install.iosNote: An iPhone sends notifications only to SHURJ opened from the Home Screen. If it asks you to pair again there, ask your manager for a new code.
install.androidMenu: Open the browser menu (⋮) and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.pushWhy: So you know when a guest writes, a table calls or a new booking waits for approval, even with the phone in your pocket.
install.serverOff: This server does not send notifications yet. The switches appear here once it does.
install.needsInstall: On an iPhone, notifications work only in SHURJ opened from the Home Screen. Add it there first (step 1).
install.insecure: Notifications need the secure (https) address. Open SHURJ at its https address.
